bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo STOP_ALL_CHANNEL_SCOPE
for unit in gace-public-video-all-joined-retry-20261114.service gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service;do
 echo BEFORE_"$unit"="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
 systemctl --user stop "$unit" 2>&1 || true
 state="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
 echo AFTER_"$unit"="$state"
 if test "$state" = active || test "$state" = activating;then echo UNAUTHORIZED_MULTI_CHANNEL_STILL_RUNNING;exit 72;fi
done
echo RESIDENT="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
echo PRIOR_ONE_CHANNEL="$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114.service -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || true)"
if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" != active;then exit 73;fi
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
test -f scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py
if test "$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114.service -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null)" = active;then
 echo SINGLE_CHANNEL_PREVIOUSLY_RUNNING
else
 if test "$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114.service -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null)" = active;then
  echo SINGLE_CHANNEL_ALREADY_RUNNING
 else
  systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py --channel-username theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV --all
  echo SINGLE_CHANNEL_HISTORY_STARTED=YES
 fi
fi
echo SINGLE_UNIT="$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114.service -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || true)"
echo ALLOWED_CHANNEL_ID=1877875443
echo OTHER_CHANNEL_JOB=STOPPED
